title: The Bone Distraction
staging:
Scene 12 — The Bone Distraction

11:00–11:45 · 45 sec · Steak & Bone security entrance

Neon activates the decoys. Several dog guards abandon their posts to chase squeaking mechanical bones. One guard tries to maintain discipline but immediately loses control when a decoy bounces past.

Shots: Guard close-up → bone rolling across floor → ears perking → chaotic chase → Ghost slipping through the unguarded entrance.
